title: Every Flame Here LEANS Toward Home 🔥
description:
In this town, a little flame floats over every head, and it always leans toward home. Mine has never once pointed at my flat.

Grandad fishes alone now, from a red hut out on the frozen lake. Every Saturday the fog rolls in, and every time it lifts, someone with no flame is standing a little nearer his door, at a slant nobody could hold.

It's made up, a creepy blocky story built with code and Blender.
pin: Comment FLAME and say which way yours would lean.
